_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Professional Engineering (PE) Analysis Report
summary: Specifies the format and content requirements for a Professional Engineering (PE) Analysis Report documenting technical studies and structural analysis, certified and stamped by a professional engineer.
use_relationship:
The Professional Engineering (PE) Analysis Report provides results of technical studies, and of structural analysis performed. The report is certified and stamped by a professional engineer (PE) and provides assurance to the government that all of the specified requirements have been met.

This data item description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The Professional Engineering Analysis Report shall be in the Contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The report shall contain a title page.

children.title: The title page shall specify the following
Introduction
children.content: The report shall contain an "Introduction" with a brief description of the analysis performed.

children.title: Design Standard
children.content: The report shall contain a "Design Standard" section and shall identify all government and industry specifications and standards used for design and loading.

children.title: Structural Analysis
children.content: The report shall contain a "Structural Analysis" section and a brief statement of the results obtained from the structural analysis.

children.title: Conclusion
children.content: The report shall contain a "Conclusion" of the condensed technical substantiations.

children.title: PE Certification
children.content: The report shall contain "PE Certification" information specifying the following:

children.title: State registered professional license stamp with expiration date
